author: Ellen (for reallifelobo)
title: Seeking ongoing artist for YouTube channel assets and thumbnails
content: ARTISTS AND DESIGNERS LISTEN UP!!! A pal of mine recently started his YouTube channel journey, and is seeking an ongoing artist to commission for assets! This guy REALLY loves to support real life human artists, and invests in human made work consistently!! He is really good people and really knows his shit. Detail update: seeking ongoing artist for main channel assets and “branded” designs, will rotate roster of thumbnail of various artists for features!! Preference given to those who can replicate Kirby style content and character drawing. You will be paid fair compensation. Contact: Comment on the post to introduce yourself; contributor @reallifelobo will review. Also DM imaginariumarts for referrals.

author: NIN Creative Studio
title: Hiring Illustrator Artists for characters, environments, fantasy and game art
content: NIN Creative Studio is Hiring! Are you passionate about Illustration and ready to turn creative ideas into compelling artwork? NIN Creative Studio is looking for Illustrator Artists – All Levels to join us on a variety of creative projects, from Characters and Creatures to Environments, Fantasy, and Game Art. Flexible Freelance / Part-time / Full-time opportunities. Send your CV + Portfolio via LinkedIn or email us at nincreativestudio@gmail.com Subject: Application – Illustrator Artist – [Your Name]
